For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced; at 5.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 2> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] A single continuous, photorealistic close-up portrait. Preserve the woman’s facial identity, hairstyle, pink lace clothing, porcelain teacup, hand anatomy, warm tea-room setting, and elegant composition from the reference images. She quietly inhales the tea’s aroma, blinks once naturally, then slowly brings the cup a fraction closer and takes a small, graceful sip. Her eyes remain softly lowered and her expression stays serene. Subtle breathing gently moves her shoulders and a few loose strands of hair. Faint steam drifts naturally upward from the tea. The camera performs an extremely slow, small push-in toward her face, with stable framing and shallow depth of field. Soft warm window light remains consistent. End smoothly in the exact pose and composition of <Picture 2>. No cuts, no talking, no lip-sync, no exaggerated movement, no identity drift, no facial deformation, no extra fingers, no warped hands or teacup, and no background morphing.

overall_soundscape:
A nearly silent tea room with faint natural room ambience, a soft breath, and one delicate porcelain contact sound as she takes the sip.
